description: Renovate is switched off for this repository on purpose. Dependabot does the
dependency updates here — see .github/dependabot.yml — and two bots reading
the same manifest would open the same pull request twice.
The Renovate app is installed on this account for every repository, and only
the account-wide 'Silent' setting is keeping it quiet. That setting is one
click away from being changed; this file is not, which is why the decision
lives here rather than in a dashboard.
browser-in-a-box is the one exception: three versions are pinned inside its
source and only a regex manager can follow them, which Dependabot has not.
